# Yatta JS

Yatta JS is a backend-as-a-server framework for building full-stack applications
without provisioning a separate backend server.

- Website: https://yattajs-docs.vercel.app
- Documentation: https://yattajs-docs.vercel.app/docs
- GitHub: https://github.com/psrockstar098/yatta.js
- Author: Dominic Rockson (psrockstar098)

## What it is

Yatta gives your application a built-in backend runtime with database,
authentication, mail, storage, APIs, background jobs, realtime communication,
and built-in observability — all embedded directly inside the native Bun runtime.

## Key features

- Bun-native runtime: database, authentication, mail, storage, APIs, jobs,
  realtime and observation built in
- SQLite in WAL mode for the embedded database
- Passkeys and MFA authentication
- S3-compatible and local file storage
- Native WebSockets for realtime communication
- Durable background job queues
- Transactional mail
- Multi-tier SWR cache
- Typed file-based routing with zero-codegen type safety
- Token-family replay defense and AES-256-GCM for security
- Starts in under 10ms

## Install

Yatta JS launches October 4, 2026. See the documentation site for install
instructions and guides once released.
